work.heading: Selected work
work.copy: My strongest work sits at the intersection of technical communication, creative production, and coordinated execution. These projects show how I define the message, build the operating plan, manage collaborators, and carry the work through publication and distribution.

items.title: Positioning and messaging
items.copy: I turn stakeholder knowledge and technical product details into positioning, messaging architecture, audience strategy, claims standards, and reusable copy systems.

items.title: Technical content
items.copy: I research and write technical documentation, articles, website copy, presentations, scripts, and social content designed for different levels of product familiarity.

items.title: Creator and community programs
items.copy: I manage creator relationships, sponsor packages, contracts, logistics, content reviews, publishing schedules, and coordinated distribution across social communities.

items.title: Multimedia and events
items.copy: I develop concepts, scripts, shot lists, decks, and production plans, then work hands-on with cameras, lighting, audio, speakers, creators, editors, and event partners.

about.heading: Strategy without losing the execution
paragraphs: I joined Phi Labs Global to manage social media for Archway. Four months later, the company sunset Archway and shifted its focus to Bolt Liquidity. As the marketing team contracted, I assumed work previously distributed across content, community, developer relations, partnerships, marketing operations, and design coordination.

That transition shaped how I work today. I can build the strategic foundation, translate a technical product, manage external relationships, and step into production or distribution when the work needs to ship. Before Web3, I spent more than a decade building audiences and managing the business behind an independent music project.
